context: A teacher walks a teen through social research
purpose: Teach: 彼女ら/これぞ/海域/空洞/戦記/歯止め/鉱物/噴出

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、論文、戦時下の女性たち、彼女らの強さ、丁寧に、論じていますね、本当に、印象的な、視点でした、桜さん、本当に、感動しました、私。
lines.en: Sakura, your paper on wartime women and their strength — you've argued it so carefully. It's a striking perspective. I was genuinely moved.
lines.style: Warm, measured opening. Speaks with the steady presence of a teacher who has read something that mattered. Thoughtful pauses between phrases. Not gushing, but genuine respect carried in the pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。これぞ、戦中の、人々の、生きざま、と、感じる証言、何人も、いただきました、本当に、貴重な、研究、できました、感謝しております。
lines.en: Yes. I was able to speak with several people who offered testimony about how people actually lived during that time. It was precious research, and I'm grateful for it.
lines.style: Respectful but not stiff. She means the gratitude. Slight hesitation before 'grateful' — checking that she's not overstating. Steady throughline, like she's still holding the weight of what she learned.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時下の、海域での悲劇、論文で、丁寧に、扱われていますね、本当に、印象的な、章でした、桜さん、本当に、読む価値の、ある、研究でした。
lines.en: The tragedy in the wartime coastal regions — you handled that chapter with such care. It was striking work, Sakura. Really valuable research.
lines.style: Softer here, even more deliberately paced. She's moved by what she read. Slight catch before 'striking' — reaching for the right word because the chapter deserves it. Warm but not intrusive.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。地方社会の空洞化、戦中、戦後、繰り返されてきたんですね、論文で、扱いました、現代にも、深く、繋がる、テーマでした、本当に、興味深い。
lines.en: Yes. I looked at how local communities hollowed out before, during, and after the war — a pattern that kept repeating. It's a theme that connects deeply to the present day. Fascinating to work through.
lines.style: Growing more confident now. She's talking about her own discovery. Slight lift on 'fascinating' — genuine intellectual engagement. Not performing, but present. Allows the ideas to breathe.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦記資料、新しい視点で、読み解いていますね、論文で、本当に、独創的な、研究、桜さん、本当に、立派です、これからも、続けて欲しいです、研究。
lines.en: You've read the historical records with such fresh eyes — a truly original approach to the material. Your work is remarkable, Sakura. I'd love to see you keep going with this.
lines.style: Direct admiration, no hedging. Speaks with the clarity of someone who knows good work when she sees it. Slight emphasis on 'original' and 'remarkable' — not flattery, assessment. Closing with genuine hope for her future.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。当時の暴力に、歯止め、かけられなかった社会、論文で、論じました、現代の、教訓に、なる視点、含めて、書きました、本当に、深い、研究でした。
lines.en: Yes. I examined a society that couldn't stop the violence of that era — couldn't hold it back. I tried to include a perspective that offers a lesson for the present. It felt important to write it that way.
lines.style: More serious now, the weight of the subject sitting in her voice. She's not reciting — she's remembering what it was like to write this. Slight deliberation before 'important.' Conviction without defensiveness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時下の鉱物採掘、強制労働の歴史、論文で、丁寧に、扱いましたね、本当に、深い研究、桜さん、人権意識、本当に、感じられる、論文でした。
lines.en: The forced labor in wartime mining operations — you treated that history with such precision and care. It's profound research, Sakura. You can really feel the human dignity in every page.
lines.style: Quiet respect. She's lingering on the difficulty of the subject and the care Sakura took. Slower pace. 'Precision' gets its own breath. Closing with genuine recognition of the ethical weight Sakura carried.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。社会の怒りが、噴出するように、出てきた時代、論文で、論じました、本当に、興味深い、転換点でしたね、本当に、深い、研究、できました、感謝です。
lines.en: Yes. I looked at a moment when society's anger finally erupted — that turning point. It was a fascinating period to explore. I learned so much working on it. I'm grateful.
lines.style: Closing statement: quieter, reflective. A sense of completion and respect for the process. Not triumphant, but settled. The gratitude lands differently here — it's for the whole journey. Slight trailing-off at the very end, like she's still holding it.
